title: Cluster explorer actual development IDE evidence
cohortDisclosure: These live explorer captures exercise the approved reviewed-source SDK cohort. Standalone packaging preserves its baseline released SDK v0.14.6 and requires separate verification; these captures do not prove that artifact cohort.

captureDisclosure: Screenshots are unmodified captures of the running development IDE. They do not prove packaged-desktop behavior or native OS window creation.
